title: clip.v2
$comment: Reader-derived projection over immutable blobs and a closed language token. No log event, seq or policy_seq is appended. Spans cover raw UTF-8 bytes on whole-line boundaries. Pairing follows LCS diff correspondence, not semantic identity or move detection. Successful results are deterministic for pinned grammar versions; transient timing/availability outcomes are never cached.

change_seq.$comment: The `seq` of the file.changed event this projection is derived from. Stamped on the response; never part of the cache key.

projection_version.$comment: Names the complete extraction algorithm and is the cache key. A dropped cache recomputes an identical result under the same version.

status.$comment: ready: every changed segment is function-derived or a corresponding null side; fallback: at least one segment is not reliably enclosed by a function, parsing failed, or a soft timeout retained bounded ranges. Inspect per-side methods/reasons and truncated independently.

fallback_reason.$comment: Required unless ready: unsupported-language, no-enclosing-function, parse-error-in-enclosing-scope, extraction-budget-exhausted, timeout, and B1 availability/budget reasons. timeout is transient even with fallback clips.

span.$comment: null means NO corresponding span on this side (created/deleted content), never unreadable content.

method.$comment: function: enclosing function rounded out to whole lines; changed-range: bounded diff range (null for no corresponding range); whole-file: no bounded diff; absent/unavailable: B1 dispositions.

reason.$comment: Present when the method needs one (e.g. `unavailable` carries the blob/snapshot reason).

byte_start.$comment: Zero-based inclusive start byte offset into the raw blob.

byte_end.$comment: Zero-based exclusive end byte offset; the span is [byte_start, byte_end). Always lands on a UTF-8 boundary.

line_end.$comment: 1-based inclusive last line covered. Lines split on \n (0x0a); a preceding \r stays in the line (CRLF preserved); a trailing newline does not create a phantom last line.

truncated.$comment: True when the per-side line/byte budget clipped this span short of the full changed range.
